markets.rules_secondary: Video of the Johnson & Johnson earnings call will be primarily used to resolve the market; if a consensus by Kalshi employees cannot be reached using video, transcripts of the Johnson & Johnson earnings call will be used according to the news publications listed in the contract. The exact phrase/word, or a plural or possessive form of the phrase/word, must be used. Grammatical/tense inflections are otherwise not included. Please see full rules for more details.
markets.title: What will Johnson & Johnson say during their next earnings call?
